items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: I've seen Chu Berry play with gloves on

ctx.x: We played drums with mittens on. I've seen saxophone players with earmuffs on. And nobody in the ballroom.

Yeah? I've seen Chu Berry play with gloves on, and I played bass with gloves on in a tobacco warehouse in West Virginia, and it was cold -- and the bus drove right into the warehouse, and we had big drums with -- what do you call those big gasoline drums and what not was filled up with -- to try to keep us warm, and there was no way.
